Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 106: February 2010
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #106 shipped to subscribers in January 2010 (bearing the cover date of February 2010 for Issue 106). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #106 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Mega Man 10 (Xbox Live Arcade retro action-platformer)
Toy Soldiers (Xbox Live Arcade action-strategy tower defense)
Perfect Dark (Xbox Live Arcade remastered FPS)
Scrap Metal (Xbox Live Arcade top-down combat racing)
Rayman 2: The Great Escape (Xbox Live Arcade classic platformer port)
Greed Corp (Xbox Live Arcade turn-based strategy)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Halo: Reach, Gears of War 3, and Portal 2, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
